StoryDescription: A shepherd boy, a giant warrior, and a God who wins the battle — the story of David and Goliath from 1 Samuel 17, told panel by panel.
PanelImageCredit: Art coming soon — Lorraine's own artwork will appear here.
PanelText: Every morning and evening, a giant warrior named Goliath stepped out from the Philistine army and shouted his challenge: “Send me a man to fight me! If he beats me, we will be your servants — but if I beat him, you will serve us!” For forty days, no one dared to answer him.
